home.description: I'm a Full-Stack Developer with extensive experience in web development and microservices. I'm a committed professional, focused on quality and continuous improvement. My attention to detail and perfectionist mindset drive me to always deliver the best possible results.

about.description: A Computer Systems Engineer with expertise in web development, APIs, and mobile apps. I focus on selecting the right tools and best practices to deliver top‑quality digital products. I also create and prototype UI/UX designs in Figma to ensure clear, interactive visual experiences. Committed and dedicated, I strive to improve every day and exceed client expectations.
